alignment_floor_note: Spanish already has the inverted-punctuation gate removing its machine-translated rows, and a 14,040-surface list with less headroom than Portuguese. Middle floor.
sentence_rules_note: require_inverted_punctuation drops any target with more '?' than '¿' or more '!' than '¡'. Spanish only: it is the cheapest reliable marker of a machine-translated subtitle track.
variety_note: Peninsular against Latin American. vosotros/ustedes is the reliable structural split; lexis is weaker because much is shared.
